title: Sign, Abs and Clamp
hints: Go's `if` has no parentheses and always needs braces: `if n < 0 { ... } else if n > 0 { ... } else { ... }`.
For `Abs`, negate with unary minus: `if n < 0 { return -n }`, then `return n` after the `if` — no `else` required.
`min(x, hi)` can never exceed `hi`; wrapping it in `max(lo, ...)` can never go below `lo`: `return max(lo, min(x, hi))`.
